prompt: Create a Python 3.12 command-line todo application. Users can add, list, complete and delete tasks. Tasks must be stored in SQLite so that they remain available after restarting the application.

intentions.text: I can add a new task to the todo list.
intentions.observable: The task is listed in the todo list after execution.

intentions.text: I can view all current tasks in the todo list.
intentions.observable: A list of all tasks is displayed in the terminal.

intentions.text: I can mark a task as complete.
intentions.requires: a task index (position in the list)
intentions.observable: The specified task is marked as complete and shown as completed in the list.

intentions.text: I can delete a task from the todo list.
intentions.requires: a task index (position in the list)
intentions.observable: The specified task is removed from the list.

intentions.text: My tasks are saved to a persistent database so they remain after restarting the application.
